title: Book Three · Chapter 166: The Coastal Packet
story:
Ronan's application packet arrives three weeks after his request.

Leo's twenty-second reply came a week earlier. His friend is asking about work and training in his own city. He has made no final agreement yet.

Today Ronan puts that letter aside and opens the large envelope from the coast.

There is a form, an instruction sheet, and a description of the programme.

The centre asks for a completed form and Ronan's own short letter. It also needs a recent note from a teacher about his school work.

His letter must answer two questions. What work has he helped with? What does he want to learn next?

Ronan reads that part twice. He remembers the cupboard and the cups. He also remembers the missing delivery cost in his sample order.

Then he looks at the deadline. The packet must arrive by the last Friday in October.

The centre reviews applications during winter. Decisions go out in the spring afterward. The new programme begins that summer.

There is another school year before the start. Ronan writes the deadline beside the class description and puts a mark beside the teacher's note.

At school, he asks his teacher about that page. She reads the request. She will write about his recent school work.

“Bring your own letter when it is ready,” she says. “I can check that the details are clear.”

Ronan thanks her. He takes the packet home and starts a rough page after lunch.

He writes the actual days and hours from his workshop work. Then he chooses one example about a customer's question.

Mum comes to the table and looks at the opening.

“A whole cupboard in the first line?”

“Only the drawing.”

She smiles and moves her cup away from the paper. Ronan makes his part clearer in the next line. He asked about the height. Mr Sun made the cupboard.

At the end of that month, Mum and Dad check their household costs again. Dad puts twelve and Mum eight into the study envelope.

This is their third actual payment of twenty. Their forty becomes sixty. With Ronan's separate forty-seven and a half, the saved amount is now one hundred and seven and a half.

Ronan writes the new amounts on his sheet. He puts no future wages below them.

That evening, he finishes the first rough version of his letter. He leaves the page beside the form. Then he closes his book with Anna's bookmark inside.

The folder has the information now. Tomorrow he can check his own answers.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

recent＝近期的；completed＝填完的、完成的；detail＝具体细节；rough version＝初稿。

## 理解问题

1. 沿海中心要哪三项材料、什么时候必须收到？Ronan已经把申请寄出了吗？
2. 父母第三次实际存钱后，他们的信封和三份合计各是多少？Leo第二十二回复是否已到？

## 读句子

**Their forty becomes sixty.**

拆开看：Their forty / becomes / sixty.

父母原有的四十元／增加为／六十元。
